## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a compliant, observable streaming pipeline at beginner level, including PII redaction and schema evolution.

## Key Concepts
- PII redaction in streaming
- JSON Schema validation
- Parquet partitioning by date/region
- Optional fields and schema evolution
- DLQ handling and CloudWatch auditing

## Code Example
```javascript
function redact(record) {
  if (record.userId) record.userId = "***REDACTED***";
  if (record.deviceId) record.deviceId = "***REDACTED***";
  return record;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you test redaction with evolving schemas?
- What changes would you make to handle large payloads?
